lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜ ਕਰੇ ਰਖੈ ਨਾਵਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooj kare rakhai naavaal ||
lines.translation: You wash your stone gods and worship them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਚੰਨਣੁ ਫੁਲ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ku(n)goo cha(n)nan phul chaRaae ||
lines.translation: You offer saffron, sandalwood and flowers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: pairee pai pai bahut manaae ||
lines.translation: Falling at their feet, you try so hard to appease them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੂਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਪੈਨੑੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanooaa ma(n)g ma(n)g painhai khaai ||
lines.translation: Begging, begging from other people, you get things to wear and eat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਅੰਧ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhee ka(n)mee a(n)dh sajaai ||
lines.translation: For your blind deeds, you will be blindly punished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਮਰਦਿਆ ਰਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhukhiaa dei na maradiaa rakhai ||
lines.translation: Your idol does not feed the hungry, or save the dying.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਝਗੜਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਸਥੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhaa jhagaRaa a(n)dhee sathai ||1||
lines.translation: The blind assembly argues in blindness. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਜੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe suratee jog sabh sabhe bed puraan ||
lines.translation: All intuitive understanding, all Yoga, all the Vedas and Puraanas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਕਰਣੇ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਗੀਤ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe karane tap sabh sabhe geet giaan ||
lines.translation: All actions, all penances, all songs and spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਬੁਧੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe budhee sudh sabh sabh teerath sabh thaan ||
lines.translation: All intellect, all enlightenment, all sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਅਮਰ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਖਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh paatisaaheeaa amar sabh sabh khuseeaa sabh khaan ||
lines.translation: All kingdoms, all royal commands, all joys and all delicacies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਵ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe maanas dev sabh sabhe jog dhiaan ||
lines.translation: All mankind, all divinites, all Yoga and meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe pureeaa kha(n)d sabh sabhe jee jahaan ||
lines.translation: All worlds, all celestial realms; all the beings of the universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਆਪਣੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਵਹੈ ਕਲਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam chalaae aapanai karamee vahai kalaam ||
lines.translation: According to His Hukam, He commands them. His Pen writes out the account of their actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਾ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa sach naai sach sabhaa deebaan ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, True is the Lord, and True is His Name. True is His Congregation and His Court. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai sukh oopajai naame gat hoee ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, peace wells up; the Name brings emancipation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai pat paaeeai hiradai har soee ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord is enshrined in the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai bhavajal la(n)gheeai phir bighan na hoee ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, and no obstructions are ever again encountered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪੰਥੁ ਪਰਗਟਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai pa(n)th paragataa naame sabh loee ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, the Path is revealed; through the Name, one is totally enlightened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur miliai naau ma(n)neeai jin devai soee ||9||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, one comes to have faith in the Name; he alone has faith, who is blessed with it. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਇਕ ਪੈਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: pureeaa kha(n)daa sir kare ik pair dhiaae ||
lines.translation: The mortal walks on his head through the worlds and realms; he meditates, balanced on one foot.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਤਲੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paun maar man jap kare sir mu(n)dee talai dei ||
lines.translation: Controlling the wind of the breath, he meditates within his mind, tucking his chin down into his chest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਟਿਕ ਟਿਕੈ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis upar ohu tik tikai kis no jor karei ||
lines.translation: What does he lean on? Where does he get his power?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis no kaheeai naanakaa kis no karataa dei ||
lines.translation: What can be said, O Nanak? Who is blessed by the Creator?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਆਪਣੈ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hukam rahaae aapanai moorakh aap ganei ||1||
lines.translation: God keeps all under His Command, but the fool shows off himself. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਹੈ ਆਖਾਂ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੀ ਹੂ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hai hai aakhaa(n) kot kot kotee hoo kot kot ||
lines.translation: He is, He is - I say it millions upon millions, millions upon millions of times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖੂੰ ਆਖਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aakhoo(n) aakhaa(n) sadaa sadaa kahan na aavai tot ||
lines.translation: With my mouth I say it, forever and ever; there is no end to this speech.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਥਕਾਂ ਨ ਠਾਕੀਆ ਏਵਡ ਰਖਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa hau thakaa(n) na thaakeeaa evad rakhahi jot ||
lines.translation: I do not get tired, and I will not be stopped; this is how great my determination is.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਸਿਅਹੁ ਚੁਖ ਬਿੰਦ ਉਪਰਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak chasiahu chukh bi(n)d upar aakhan dos ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this is tiny and insignificant. To say that it is more, is wrong. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai kul udharai sabh kuta(n)b sabaaiaa ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, all one's ancestors and family are saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਿਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai sa(n)gat udharai jin ridai vasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, one's associates are saved; enshrine it within your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai sun udhare jin rasan rasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, those who hear it are saved; let your tongue delight in it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai dukh bhukh gaee jin naam chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, pain and hunger are dispelled; let your consciousness be attached to the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam tinee saalaahiaa jin guroo milaaiaa ||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they alone Praise the Name, who meet with the Guru. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਦਿਹ ਸਭਿ ਥਿਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe raatee sabh dih sabh thitee sabh vaar ||
lines.translation: All nights, all days, all dates, all days of the week;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਤਂੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe rutee maah sabh sabh dharata(n)ee sabh bhaar ||
lines.translation: All seasons, all months, all the earth and everything on it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਉਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe paanee paun sabh sabh aganee paataal ||
lines.translation: All waters, all winds, all fires and underworlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਅ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe pureeaa kha(n)d sabh sabh lo lo aakaar ||
lines.translation: All solar systems and galaxies, all worlds, people and forms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam na jaapee ketaRaa kahi na sakeejai kaar ||
lines.translation: No one knows how great the Hukam of His Command is; no one can describe His actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਹਿ ਥਕਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਂੀ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aakhahi thakahi aakh aakh kar siphata(n)ee veechaar ||
lines.translation: Mortals may utter, chant, recite and contemplate His Praises until they grow weary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: trin na paaio bapuRee naanak kahai gavaar ||1||
lines.translation: The poor fools, O Nanak, cannot find even a tiny bit of the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖਂੀ ਪਰਣੈ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾਂ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: akha(n)ee paranai je phiraa(n) dekhaa(n) sabh aakaar ||
lines.translation: If I were to walk around with my eyes wide open, gazing at all the created forms;

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਾ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਪੰਡਿਤਾਂ ਪੁਛਾ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: puchhaa giaanee pa(n)ditaa(n) puchhaa bed beechaar ||
lines.translation: I could ask the spiritual teachers and religious scholars, and those who contemplate the Vedas;
